## Validation

- [ ] I edited `content/community/Qxxxx/<locale>.md`, not the generated answer JSON.
- [ ] The answer explains Principle, Trade-off, Implementation, and Production; optional Advanced material is clearly separated.
- [ ] I preserved the original repository and pinned question links and credited additional sources.
- [ ] I checked assumptions, formulas, code, and any claimed measurements; examples are identified as examples.
- [ ] I filled in the author, date, and review metadata and can contribute this text under Apache-2.0.
- [ ] I ran `npm run validate`, `npm test`, `npm run check`, and `npm run build`, or explained why I could not.

Maintainers: review technical accuracy, attribution, language, and the source fingerprint before merging. A green CI run checks structure; it does not establish technical correctness.
